objective:
$ADAM — official X: https://x.com/IaMaDamIMD — independent security audit of the ADAM project (continue from parent job). Single job, do NOT ask clarifying questions.

## Scope
- All first-party contracts at the current head (PR #2): LaunchToken, AdamHook, AdamTreasuryV2, AdamDistributorV2, AdamSplitOracle, NFTClaim, plus script/DeployAdam.s.sol (hook-only mode) and script/DeployAdamExtension.s.sol.
- Intended mainnet setup: fresh ADAM token → DeployAdamExtension (oracle, DistributorV2, NFTClaim funded with 110,000,000 ADAM, TreasuryV2) → DeployAdam hook-only with TreasuryV2 → single-sided ETH/ADAM v4 pool. Legacy V1 Distributor/Treasury will NOT be deployed on mainnet.

## Process
- Independent reviewers (not the original author), each focused on: math/accounting, access control & immutability, economic/MEV attacks (process(), keeper bounty, reward legs, price floors, reroute), oracle verification (IMD Oracle v2 EIP-712 attestation, signer, questionHash, quorum, freshness, replay, clamps, fallback), NFTClaim (per-tokenId unlock, ownership checks, transfers mid-vesting, batch, claimAndStake, burnUnclaimed), IMDSTR buy-on-claim + one-time direct switch, deploy scripts (ordering, funding, hook mining, pool init, LP ticks).
- A judge consolidates findings.
- Fix every Critical / High / Medium finding with a regression test. Do NOT add features or change economics (fees, splits, allocations, unlock schedule, bounds).

## Deliverables
1. AUDIT.md: findings by severity with status (fixed / acknowledged + reasoning), and a mainnet deployment checklist with exact constructor parameters to verify.
2. Fixes + regression tests (unit, fuzz, mainnet fork). All tests green.
3. README updated only where behavior changed.
Nothing is broadcast; deployer signs manually.
